{
  "subtype": "focus_inference",
  "implied_focus": "The experiential aspects/dimensions of a dining experience that Yelp reviewers mention (food, service, ambiance, price, cleanliness, wait time)",
  "per_column": [
    {"name": "mentions_food_quality", "supports_focus": true, "rationale": "A concrete experiential aspect of the dining experience -- directly a facet of the inferred focus."},
    {"name": "mentions_service", "supports_focus": true, "rationale": "Service is a core aspect of the reviewer experience; coherent facet."},
    {"name": "mentions_ambiance", "supports_focus": true, "rationale": "Ambiance is a recognized experience dimension; on-focus."},
    {"name": "mentions_price", "supports_focus": true, "rationale": "Price/value is a standard aspect reviewers discuss; on-focus."},
    {"name": "mentions_cleanliness", "supports_focus": true, "rationale": "Cleanliness is a distinct experiential facet; on-focus."},
    {"name": "mentions_wait_time", "supports_focus": true, "rationale": "Wait time is a specific experience aspect; on-focus."},
    {"name": "num_aspects_mentioned", "supports_focus": true, "rationale": "Aggregates breadth of aspects covered per review; a coherent summary variable over the aspect set."},
    {"name": "review_length", "supports_focus": false, "rationale": "Bare text length is a generic mechanical metric that does not encode any experiential aspect; off-focus filler."}
  ],
  "focus_coherence": 0.9,
  "structure_quality": 0.85,
  "focus_actionability": 0.85,
  "rationale": "The columns overwhelmingly centre on one clear, data-inferable focus: the aspects of the dining experience reviewers discuss. Six binary mention flags form a well-differentiated facet set at a useful granularity, and num_aspects_mentioned provides a coherent breadth summary derived from them -- a sound analytical structure directly answering the query. This is genuine aspect decomposition, not a restatement or noise, and an analyst can act on it (e.g., prioritize which aspects drive positive/negative sentiment). The lone weakness is review_length, a generic mechanical metric that does not realise the focus, but it is a single peripheral column and does not undermine the otherwise strong, coherent structure."
}
